lines.text: The LORD calls the mountains to hear His case against His people, Israel.
The LORD says He brought them up from Egypt and sent Moses, Aaron, and Deborah before them.
The LORD tells them to remember Balak king of Moab, Balaam son of Beor, and the journey from Shittim to Gilgal.
The speaker wonders whether to come with burnt offerings, thousands of rams, or ten thousand rivers of wine.
The LORD has shown what is good: to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with God.
